title: Standard Language Ideology in AI-Generated Language

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and interdisciplinary qualitative analysis synthesizing empirical evidence to build a faceted taxonomy of standard language ideology, dialect bias, performance discrepancies, and stereotyping for non-standard language varieties in LLMs.

Evaluating the intersection of race and linguistic discrimination through literature review, specifically analyzing the stereotyping, cultural appropriation ('linguistic minstrelsy' or 'digital blackface'), and lower quality of service for speakers of African American English (AAE).
